object_description: S-shaped elongated building complex enclosing a grass-field courtyard
design_condition: The S-shaped complex works with the eastern manufacturing building to enclose a grass-field outdoor space, while a small forecourt addresses Grüntalstrasse and the sports hall connects directly to neighboring parking.

positive.statement: The project offers an innovative solution by combining kindergarten, school and sports hall under one roof.
The enclosed outdoor space creates an attractive spatial atmosphere for the complex.
The escape balconies allow the central corridor to be used as a teaching zone and shade the glazed facades in summer.
The sports hall is easy to reach from the neighboring parking spaces and can also be entered directly from the school.
The planned green facade can be expected to create an attractive spatial atmosphere in the classrooms.

negative.statement: Access to the kindergarten and school is difficult to find.
The kindergarten does not have its own outdoor space.
The high glass content has a negative impact on costs and operating energy.
The cloakrooms are only accessible through the public area and stands.
